bug_info.bug_desc: The SFENCE.VMA decoder does not validate that the rd field (bits [11:7]) must be zero per the RISC-V privileged specification. When a SFENCE.VMA instruction has a non-zero rd field (e.g., rd=1), the decoder incorrectly treats it as a valid SFENCE.VMA instead of raising an illegal instruction exception. This allows malformed instructions to execute without trapping, causing divergence from the ISA specification and co-simulation mismatches with reference models like Spike.
bug_info.fix_hint: When privilege checks pass, preserve the earlier `illegal_instr` result instead of forcing it to zero, so the existing nonzero-rd encoding check remains effective.
